Known for its clean nutritional profile, WPI is a great option for those aiming to increase daily protein intake while following a low-carb or lactose-conscious diet. This protein powder contains a naturally occurring amino acid profile and is commonly used to support an active lifestyle and balanced nutrition goals.

Produced by Warrior, this Clear Whey Isolate delivers a lighter fruity twist to the classic protein milkshake of the past. Perfect for when you need a fast protein hit without that bloaty feeling, Warrior Clear Whey Isolate is sippable and drinkable like a normal fruit juice. Using only the purest of whey isolates, servings of 25-grams are 90% protein (22.56-grams to be precise), come virtually sugar-free and are super low in calories, fats and carbs. matches_set.description: Tasteless Protein by Feel Good Protein® is a tasteless protein powder created for those who want a simple, versatile way to include more protein in their day, without changing the taste, smell, or texture of their foods and drinks. Perfect for anyone on their health, wellness and fitness journey! Made from high-quality hydrolysed collagen, Tasteless Protein dissolves easily and mixes without graininess. Its fine texture and neutral flavour make it an effortless addition to coffee, smoothies, yoghurt, soups and everyday meals. Each serve provides 14.2 g of protein and delivers all 9 essential amino acids, which is commonly missing from other collagen supplements. With no fats, sugars, carbohydrates, gluten or dairy, Tasteless Protein is a popular choice for people who prefer a lighter, more flexible protein option that fits easily into a wide range of routines and lifestyles.

matches_set.description: Good news! We have managed to turn a guilty pleasure into a healthy treat. Meet the ultimate chocolate craving satisfier – ProteinWise Chocolate Instant Protein Drink! It’s a great tasting, creamy drink that can tame cravings with a rich, distinctively delightful chocolate flavor. Our Chocolate Instant Protein Drink is healthy and diet friendly with only 90 calories per serving, which makes it a no-guilt alternative to traditional fatty shakes. Finally, a diet chocolate drink that you can enjoy as much as you want, with no regrets! Easy to prepare and definitely easy to enjoy! Just mix with water and it is ready in seconds.
